_about: Exercise library. frames = pose names from poses.json (the demo loops through them). tempo = seconds per frame. impact high = jumping/bouncing; lowImpactAlt is swapped in when Low-Impact mode is on. reviewed_by/reviewed_on are filled in by the PT/phys-ed review (SPEC 13a).

exercises.name: March in Place
cues: Drive knees up toward hip height
Swing the opposite arm
Stand tall, brace your core
exercises.mistake: Shuffling with tiny steps. Lift the knees.

exercises.name: Jog in Place
cues: Light, quick feet
Land on the balls of your feet
Relax your shoulders

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
cues: Jump feet wide as arms go overhead
Soft knees on every landing
Keep a steady rhythm

exercises.name: Step Jacks
cues: Step one foot out as arms go up
Alternate sides
Move with purpose. No jumping needed.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
cues: Arms straight out to the sides
Small circles, getting bigger
Switch direction halfway
exercises.mistake: Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.

exercises.name: Leg Swings
cues: Hold a wall or chair for balance
Swing forward and back, relaxed
Keep the standing knee soft
exercises.mistake: Arching the lower back on the back swing.

exercises.name: Hip Circles
cues: Hands on hips, feet hip-width
Draw big slow circles with your hips
Switch direction halfway
exercises.mistake: Moving the shoulders instead of the hips.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
cues: Step into a deep lunge, hands down
Rotate and reach the inside arm to the ceiling
Follow your hand with your eyes
exercises.mistake: Letting the front knee cave inward.

exercises.name: Inchworm
cues: Fold forward, hands to the floor
Walk hands out to a plank
Walk back and roll up tall
exercises.mistake: Letting the hips sag in the plank.

exercises.name: Scap Push-Up
cues: High plank, arms straight
Let the chest sink between your shoulder blades
Push the floor away to round back up
exercises.mistake: Bending the elbows. Only the shoulder blades move.

exercises.name: High Knees
cues: Knees to hip height
Pump the arms
Stay on the balls of your feet
exercises.mistake: Leaning back to lift the knees.

exercises.name: Butt Kicks
cues: Kick heels toward your glutes
Quick, light feet
Knees point down

exercises.name: Wall Push-Up
cues: Hands on the wall at shoulder height
Body in one straight line
Bring your chest to the wall, then push away

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
cues: Hands on a sturdy counter, bench or couch arm
Elbows about 45° from your body
Lower your chest to the edge
exercises.mistake: Flaring elbows straight out to the sides.

exercises.name: Knee Push-Up
cues: Knees down, hands under shoulders
Straight line from knees to head
Chest to the floor, then press up
exercises.mistake: Bending at the hips instead of keeping a straight line.

exercises.name: Push-Up
cues: Hands just wider than shoulders
Squeeze glutes, body like a plank
Lower until your chest nearly touches
exercises.mistake: Sagging hips or a half-range rep.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
cues: Hips high in an upside-down V
Lower the top of your head toward the floor
Press back up through the shoulders
exercises.mistake: Turning it into a regular push-up by dropping the hips.

exercises.name: Chair Squat
cues: Sit back to a chair behind you
Tap it lightly, don't plop
Drive through your heels to stand

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out
Hips back and down, chest proud
Thighs to parallel or as deep as is comfortable

exercises.name: Split Squat
cues: Long stance, back heel up
Drop the back knee straight down
Front heel stays planted
exercises.mistake: Pushing off the back foot instead of the front leg.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
cues: Step one foot back
Lower the back knee toward the floor
Drive through the front heel to return
exercises.mistake: Front knee drifting way past the toes or caving in.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
cues: Rise onto the balls of your feet
Pause at the top
Lower slowly

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
cues: Feet flat, knees bent
Squeeze glutes and lift hips
Straight line from knees to shoulders
exercises.mistake: Arching the lower back instead of using the glutes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cues: One foot down, other leg straight
Drive through the planted heel
Keep hips level

exercises.name: Superman
cues: Lie face down, arms overhead
Lift arms, chest and legs together
Hold for a breath, then lower
exercises.mistake: Cranking the neck up. Eyes stay on the floor.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
cues: Lower back pressed into the floor
Extend opposite arm and leg slowly
Breathe out as you reach
exercises.mistake: Lower back peeling off the floor.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
cues: Elbows under shoulders
Squeeze glutes and brace your abs
Breathe steadily

exercises.name: Bird Dog
cues: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips
Reach opposite arm and leg long
Keep your back flat like a table

exercises.name: Wall Sit
cues: Back flat on the wall
Thighs parallel to the floor
Knees over ankles

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
cues: High plank, hands under shoulders
Drive knees toward your chest
Hips stay level

exercises.name: Squat Jump
cues: Squat down, swing the arms
Explode up
Land softly back into the squat

exercises.name: Burpee
cues: Squat, hands down
Jump feet back to a plank
Jump feet in and leap up

exercises.name: Step-Back Burpee
cues: Squat, hands down
Step one foot back, then the other
Step in and stand tall
exercises.mistake: Rushing and losing the plank position.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
cues: Knees wide, big toes together
Sit hips back toward heels
Reach arms long and breathe into your back

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
cues: Legs straight out in front
Hinge forward from the hips
Reach toward shins or toes
exercises.mistake: Rounding hard through the upper back.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch
cues: Hold a wall for balance
Pull your heel to your glute
Knees side by side
exercises.mistake: Knee drifting out to the side.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
cues: Half-kneel, back knee on a soft surface
Tuck your tailbone, squeeze the back glute
Shift hips forward gently
exercises.mistake: Arching the lower back to fake the stretch.

exercises.name: Knees to Chest
cues: Lie on your back
Hug both knees in
Rock gently side to side if it feels good
exercises.mistake: Lifting your head off the floor.

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
cues: Forearm on a wall or door frame behind you
Turn your body away
Feel it across the chest, not the shoulder joint

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
cues: Bring one arm across your chest
Hug it in with the other arm above the elbow
Keep the shoulder down
exercises.mistake: Pulling on the elbow joint itself.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
cues: Reach one hand down your back
Gently press the elbow with the other hand
Stand tall, ribs down

exercises.name: Cobra
cues: Lie face down, hands under shoulders
Press up gently, hips stay down
Shoulders away from ears
exercises.mistake: Locking the elbows and jamming the lower back.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
cues: Hands and feet down, hips high
Press the floor away, long spine
Bend knees as much as you need
exercises.mistake: Rounding the back to force the heels down.

exercises.name: Box Breathing
cues: Breathe in for 4
Hold for 4
Breathe out for 4, hold for 4

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
cues: Feet up on a step, couch or chair
Hands just wider than shoulders
Lower with control, body stays straight

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
cues: Hands close together under your chest
Elbows track back along your sides
Full range, chest to hands

exercises.name: Archer Push-Up
cues: Very wide hands
Shift your weight over one arm as you lower
The other arm stays nearly straight

exercises.name: Elevated Pike Push-Up
cues: Feet on a chair, hips stacked high
Lower the head between your hands
Press straight back up
exercises.mistake: Dropping the hips toward a regular push-up.

exercises.name: Wall Handstand Hold
cues: Walk your feet up the wall, chest facing it
Arms locked, push the floor away
Squeeze glutes, ribs in
exercises.mistake: Banana back. Keep the body in a line.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Back foot on a couch or chair
Drop straight down on the front leg
Front heel stays planted
exercises.mistake: Standing too close to the bench.

exercises.name: Shrimp Squat
cues: Hold one foot behind you
Lower the back knee to the floor
Stand up without pushing off the back foot
exercises.mistake: Rushing. Go slow and control it.

exercises.name: Assisted Pistol Squat
cues: Hold a door frame or post
One leg straight out in front
Sit down on the other leg as low as you can control
exercises.mistake: Pulling too hard with the arms.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
cues: Arms forward for balance
Free leg straight out
Full depth, then stand tall

exercises.name: Elevated Hip Thrust
cues: Upper back on the couch edge
Drive hips up to a flat tabletop
Chin tucked, ribs down
exercises.mistake: Arching the lower back at the top.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
cues: Soft knee on the standing leg
Hinge forward as the back leg lifts
Hips stay square to the floor
exercises.mistake: Rounding the back to reach lower.

exercises.name: Sliding Hamstring Curl
cues: Lie on your back, heels on a towel (smooth floor)
Lift hips into a bridge
Slide heels out and back in

exercises.name: Prone Y-T-W
cues: Lie face down, forehead on a towel
Lift arms into a Y, then T, then W
Squeeze shoulder blades together

exercises.name: Doorframe Row
cues: Grip both sides of a sturdy door frame
Lean back with arms straight
Pull your chest to the frame
exercises.mistake: Using hips instead of arms and back.

exercises.name: Towel Door Row
cues: Loop a towel around the handles of a closed, locked door
Lean back, walk feet closer to make it harder
Row elbows back past your ribs
exercises.mistake: Using a door that opens toward you.

exercises.name: Table Inverted Row
cues: Lie under a very sturdy table, grip the edge
Body straight, heels on the floor
Pull your chest up to the table
exercises.mistake: Using a wobbly table. Test it first!

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
cues: Lower back glued to the floor
Arms overhead, legs long and low
Bend the knees to make it easier
exercises.mistake: Lower back arching off the floor.

exercises.name: Side Plank
cues: Elbow under shoulder
Hips lifted in a straight line
Knees down to make it easier

exercises.name: V-Up
cues: Start long on your back
Lift arms and legs to meet in the middle
Lower slowly

exercises.name: Tuck L-Sit
cues: Hands on two sturdy chairs or the floor
Push down and lift your hips
Knees tucked to chest

exercises.name: Crow Pose
cues: Hands flat, knees on the backs of your arms
Lean forward until the feet float
Pillow in front of your face!
exercises.mistake: Looking down at your hands. Look forward.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
cues: High plank, feet wide
Tap the opposite shoulder
Hips stay still
exercises.mistake: Rocking the hips side to side.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
cues: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at your chest
Sit down between your heels
Elbows inside the knees at the bottom

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Weights in front of the thighs
Push hips back, soft knees
Stop when the hamstrings are stretched, then stand

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
cues: Hike the bell back between your legs
Snap the hips forward to float it to chest height
Arms are just ropes
exercises.mistake: Squatting the swing or lifting with the arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent
Press the weights up over your chest
Lower until the elbows touch the floor

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
cues: Weights at the shoulders
Press straight up, biceps by the ears
Ribs down, glutes tight
exercises.mistake: Leaning back to finish the rep.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: Hand and knee on a couch or bench
Pull the weight to your hip
Pause, then lower slowly

exercises.name: Gorilla Row
cues: Wide stance, hinge forward, weights on the floor
Row one weight while the other stays down
Alternate sides

exercises.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
cues: Elbows pinned to your sides
Curl up, squeeze at the top
Lower slowly. No swinging

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
cues: Weights at your sides
Step back, back knee toward the floor
Drive through the front heel

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
cues: Heavy weights at your sides
Stand tall, shoulders back
Walk with short, controlled steps

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
cues: Weight locked out over your shoulder, eyes on it
Roll to elbow, hand, hips up, sweep the leg, stand
Reverse it slowly
exercises.mistake: Rushing. Every step is a pause.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Clean & Press
cues: Hinge and pull the weights up to the shoulders
Dip the knees and press overhead
Lower with control
exercises.mistake: Curling the weights up instead of using the hips.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
cues: Overhand grip, arms straight
Shoulders gently pulled down
Breathe and hold

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-Up
cues: Hang with straight arms
Pull shoulder blades down and back to lift a little
Lower slowly

exercises.name: Negative Pull-Up
cues: Jump or step up so your chin is over the bar
Lower yourself over 5 seconds
Reset and repeat

exercises.name: Pull-Up
cues: Overhand grip, just wider than shoulders
Pull your chest toward the bar
Full hang at the bottom

exercises.name: Chin-Up
cues: Underhand grip, shoulder width
Chin over the bar
Lower all the way down
exercises.mistake: Craning the neck to reach the bar.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
cues: Hang still
Curl knees up toward your chest
Lower without swinging

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Hang still, legs straight
Lift legs to hip height or higher
Control the way down

exercises.name: Split Jump
cues: Start in a lunge
Jump and switch legs in the air
Land softly back in a lunge
exercises.mistake: Landing with a stiff front knee.

exercises.name: Tuck Jump
cues: Jump high
Pull knees to chest
Land softly and go again

exercises.name: Broad Jump
cues: Swing arms back, hinge
Jump forward as far as you can
Stick the landing, walk back

exercises.name: Skaters
cues: Bound sideways onto one foot
Back foot sweeps behind
Touch down lightly and bound back

exercises.name: Plank Jacks
cues: High plank
Jump feet wide and back together
Hips stay level

exercises.name: Star Jumps
cues: Squat down a little
Explode up into a star shape
Land softly

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
cues: Hands and feet, knees hovering an inch up
Move opposite hand and foot together
Keep your back flat

exercises.name: Mountain Pose
cues: Feet hip-width, weight even
Lengthen through the crown of the head
Soft breath through the nose

exercises.name: Tree Pose
cues: Foot on the inner calf or thigh (not the knee)
Hands at heart or overhead
Fix your gaze on one spot
exercises.mistake: Pressing the foot into the side of the knee.

exercises.name: Warrior I
cues: Long stance, back heel down at an angle
Bend the front knee over the ankle
Arms reach up, hips face forward

exercises.name: Warrior II
cues: Wide stance, front knee over the ankle
Arms out long, shoulders relaxed
Gaze over the front hand
exercises.mistake: Leaning the torso over the front leg.

exercises.name: Triangle Pose
cues: Wide stance, front leg straight
Reach forward, then tip the hand down to shin or block
Top arm reaches to the sky

exercises.name: Chair Pose
cues: Sit back like there's a chair
Arms reach up alongside the ears
Weight in the heels
exercises.mistake: Knees shooting past the toes with heels lifting.

exercises.name: Low Lunge
cues: Back knee down, front knee over ankle
Sink the hips forward
Lift the chest, arms up if it feels good
exercises.mistake: Front knee way past the toes.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose
cues: Front shin angled across the mat
Back leg long behind you
Fold forward if it feels good
exercises.mistake: Forcing it. Prop the hip on a pillow.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
cues: Hands and knees
Breathe in: drop the belly, lift the chest (cow)
Breathe out: round the spine (cat)
exercises.mistake: Moving only the neck. Use the whole spine.

exercises.name: Boat Pose
cues: Sit tall, lean back slightly
Lift the shins parallel to the floor
Arms forward. Straighten legs to make it harder

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
cues: From hands and knees, slide one arm under the other
Rest shoulder and temple down
Breathe into the upper back

exercises.name: Supine Twist
cues: Lie on your back, hug one knee in
Let it fall across your body
Arms wide, both shoulders down
exercises.mistake: Forcing the knee to the floor.

exercises.name: Bridge Pose
cues: Feet under knees, arms by your sides
Lift hips and roll the chest open
Breathe steadily

exercises.name: Figure-4 Stretch
cues: On your back, ankle over the opposite knee
Pull the bottom thigh toward you
Keep the crossed foot flexed

exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch
cues: Sit tall, soles of feet together
Let the knees fall open
Hinge forward gently

exercises.name: Wall Calf Stretch
cues: Hands on a wall, one foot back
Back heel down, back leg straight
Lean in until you feel the calf

exercises.name: Neck Side Stretch
cues: Sit or stand tall
Tip one ear toward the shoulder
Let the other shoulder drop

exercises.name: Brisk Walk
cues: Walk at a pace where you can talk but not sing
Swing the arms
Tall posture

exercises.name: Connection Breath
cues: Breathe in: let ribs, belly and pelvic floor gently widen
Breathe out: feel the pelvic floor and deep belly gently lift and draw in
Keep it soft, about 30% effort
exercises.mistake: Bracing hard or holding your breath.

exercises.name: Pelvic Floor Lifts
cues: Sit tall and breathe normally
Gently lift and squeeze as if stopping gas and urine, hold 3 to 5 seconds
Fully let go between reps. The relax matters as much as the lift
exercises.mistake: Squeezing glutes or thighs, or holding your breath.

exercises.name: Pelvic Floor Quick Flicks
cues: Quick lift and squeeze
Let go completely
Repeat at a steady rhythm

exercises.name: Heel Slides
cues: On your back, knees bent
Breathe out, gently draw in the deep belly
Slide one heel out slowly, then back
exercises.mistake: Lower back arching as the leg slides.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilts
cues: On your back, knees bent
Breathe out and gently flatten your back into the floor
Breathe in and release
exercises.mistake: Pushing with the feet or lifting the hips.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Clamshell
cues: Lie on your side, knees bent, heels together
Lift the top knee without rolling the hips back
Lower slowly

exercises.name: Side-Lying Leg Lift
cues: Lie on your side, bottom knee bent
Lift the top leg straight, toes forward
Lower with control
exercises.mistake: Turning the toes up to the ceiling.

exercises.name: Wall Squat
cues: Back against a wall, feet a step forward
Slide down to a comfortable depth
Breathe out as you slide back up

exercises.name: Incline Plank
cues: Hands on a counter or sturdy table
Walk feet back to a straight line
Breathe steadily, no straining
exercises.mistake: Holding your breath or bulging the belly.
